notes: Editable Mix Review Lab targets. Use metric for top-level metrics, or path for nested metrics such as tonal_balance.low_end_share.

premaster.summary: Premaster checks favour headroom, translation, and enough dynamics for mastering.

checks.label: Peak headroom
checks.education: Premasters need space for mastering moves and delivery encoding.

checks.label: True peak safety
checks.target: True peak at or below -1 dBFS
checks.education: Inter-sample peaks can clip even when sample peaks look safe.

checks.label: Useful dynamics
checks.education: Some punch left in the mix gives mastering more room to work.

checks.label: Low-end proportion
checks.target: Low end below 52% of broad energy
checks.education: Too much low end can make a premaster feel loud but small.

checks.label: Stereo stability
checks.education: Important mix elements should survive mono playback.

club.summary: Club/electronic checks prioritise controlled bass power, punch, and mono-safe low end.

checks.label: Club low-end weight
checks.education: Dance mixes can be bass-forward, but the low end still needs control.

checks.label: Low-end mono safety
checks.education: Club playback usually rewards centred kick and bass foundations.

checks.label: Low-band phase
checks.education: Phasey low end can lose weight when summed or played on large systems.

checks.label: Punch reserve
checks.education: A loud electronic mix still needs enough transient shape to hit.

pop_vocal.summary: Pop vocal checks focus on intelligibility, low-mid masking, and comfortable brightness.

checks.label: Vocal clarity band
checks.education: A vocal-led mix needs enough upper-mid information to read at low volume.

checks.label: Low-mid masking
checks.education: Dense low mids can hide lyric detail and make reverbs feel cloudy.

checks.label: Harshness guard
checks.education: Brightness should help the vocal speak without making S/T sounds painful.

checks.label: Lead translation
checks.education: A vocal can be wide around the edges, but the lead should stay anchored.

rap_vocal.summary: Rap vocal checks protect lyric focus against dense drums and bass.

checks.label: Lyric clarity band
checks.education: Fast vocals need enough edge to stay intelligible over drums.

checks.label: Bass masking
checks.education: Kick and 808 energy can mask vocal body when the balance is too low-heavy.

checks.label: Low-mid room
checks.education: The vocal body needs room around the lower mids without becoming boxy.

checks.label: Punch reserve
checks.education: Rap mixes often work loud, but the drum pocket still needs impact.

podcast.summary: Podcast/dialogue checks prioritise stable level, speech clarity, and listener comfort.

checks.label: Consistent level
checks.education: Speech should not force the listener to keep adjusting volume.

checks.label: Speech clarity
checks.education: Clear consonants help speech translate on phones and laptops.

checks.label: Low rumble control
checks.education: Rumble and plosives eat headroom and make dialogue feel muddy.

checks.label: Peak safety
checks.education: Speech exports still need room for platform encoding.

game_audio.summary: Game audio checks favour implementation headroom, reliable playback, and repeatable loudness.

checks.label: Implementation headroom
checks.target: True peak at or below -1 dBFS
checks.education: Interactive playback can stack sounds, so assets need safe headroom.

checks.label: Playback consistency
checks.education: Game assets should remain usable across varied playback contexts.

checks.label: Low-end control
checks.education: Low-frequency build-up multiplies quickly when several assets play together.

checks.label: Mono compatibility
checks.education: Game audio often reaches mono, phone, TV, and headset playback paths.

master.summary: Master checks focus on delivery safety, loudness damage, and final translation.

checks.label: True peak ceiling
checks.target: True peak at or below -0.3 dBFS
checks.education: A safer ceiling reduces codec and platform clipping risk.

checks.label: No clipping
checks.education: A finished master should not rely on accidental digital clipping.

checks.label: Punch after limiting
checks.education: Very low crest factor can mean limiting is flattening the music.

checks.label: Stereo stability
checks.education: Wide masters still need a stable image and mono compatibility.
